title: @bsh/degent-mint environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Secrets (marked x-secret) come from the secret store, never from the repo. Variables marked x-required-unless-regtest may be omitted only when NETWORK=regtest (dev defaults: in-memory stores, dev reveal key, ephemeral parent key). Mainnet additionally requires SIGNER=remote (SIGNER_URL, SIGNER_API_KEY, SIGNER_KEY_ID) and AMQP_URL.

NETWORK.description: Bitcoin network. mainnet refuses dev-only adapters.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite database file (orders, meta incl. parent state and value alert, editions, encrypted reveals). Required off regtest: production networks never run in-memory stores.

CONTENT_DIR.description: Content-addressed blob directory (<dir>/<aa>/<sha256>). Required off regtest: production networks never run an in-memory content store.

ESPLORA_URL.description: esplora / mempool.space-compatible REST base, e.g. https://mempool.space/api. Also the standard-lane broadcaster (POST /tx).

ORD_URL.description: ord server base; GET /content/<inscription id> is used for verification.

LIBRE_RPC_URL.description: Libre Relay bitcoind JSON-RPC URL (block lane). Mainnet needs this and/or SLIPSTREAM_URL.

SLIPSTREAM_URL.description: MARA Slipstream base URL (block lane), e.g. https://slipstream.mara.com.

PARENT_OUTPOINT.description: Initial location of the parent UTXO; only read when the store has none yet.

PARENT_VALUE_SATS.description: Constant value of the parent UTXO (sats). Published in GET /v1/config as parentValueSats; browsers pre-commit output 0 to it (SIGHASH_ALL|ANYONECANPAY, ADR-0005). Startup refuses a PARENT_OUTPOINT whose value differs.

SIGNER.description: Policy signer backend. 'memory' (PARENT_KEY_FILE / random regtest key) is dev-only and refused on mainnet. 'remote' calls the platform signer service (@bsh/signer) through its client; the key stays there (HSM port behind it) and the mint still runs evaluateParentPolicy before every request. Mainnet starts ONLY with 'remote'. 'kms' is retired and refused with a pointer to 'remote'.

SIGNER_URL.description: SIGNER=remote: base URL of the platform signer service on the private network (e.g. http://signer.internal:3060). Required with SIGNER=remote.

SIGNER_API_KEY.description: SIGNER=remote: @bsh/edge API key of the signer with scope sign:<SIGNER_KEY_ID> (and nothing else). Live key required on mainnet.

SIGNER_KEY_ID.description: SIGNER=remote: signer key id holding the collection parent key (e.g. degent-parent). Startup checks p2tr(key) == COLLECTION_ADDRESS.

SIGNER_RETRIES.description: SIGNER=remote: extra attempts on network errors, timeouts, 429 and 5xx (0-10). Safe: re-signing input 0 of the same unsigned tx yields the same txid. 4xx are never retried.

PARENT_KEY_FILE.description: DEV ONLY (SIGNER=memory): file with the 32-byte hex parent key. Rejected on mainnet and with SIGNER=remote.

COLLECTION_ADDRESS.description: Taproot address of the parent key; must equal the signer's address (SIGNER=remote: checked against the signer's SIGNER_KEY_ID at startup, so also required on regtest).

REVEAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM key (hex) encrypting stored half-signed reveals.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact origins allowed for browser calls. Empty = deny all.

ART_REVIEW_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Unset disables the vision review (rules review still runs).

ART_REVIEW_GUIDELINES_FILE.description: Optional text file replacing the default art guidelines prompt.

SERVICE_FEE_ADDRESS.description: Address that must receive the service fee in the funding tx. Required if a fee is set.

STANDARD_CONCURRENCY.description: Standard-lane reveals in flight (1-24; the parent chain must stay under the 25-descendant mempool limit).

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: POST/PUT requests per client IP per minute.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Use the first X-Forwarded-For hop as the client IP (only behind a trusted proxy).

STUDIO_URL.description: Open Studio (ADR-0007): base URL of @bsh/degent-studio. Enables artwork orders (POST /v1/orders with artworkId). Unset = artwork orders refused (regtest wires an empty in-memory studio).

STUDIO_API_KEY.description: Studio API key with scope studio:internal (reads any artwork, records royalties). Required off regtest when STUDIO_URL is set.

LEDGER_URL.description: Platform ledger base URL (plan 3.5). Each artwork order is recorded as a ledger order with payee line items and a psbt intent; failures never block a mint. Unset = not recorded (regtest wires an in-memory ledger).

LEDGER_API_KEY.description: Ledger API key (scope ledger, owner degent). Required off regtest when LEDGER_URL is set.

ROYALTY_BPS.description: Artist royalty in basis points of the mint price (commitValue + clubFee), 0-10000. Published in GET /v1/config as royaltyBps.

CLUB_FEE_BPS_STANDARD.description: Club fee for Standard Degent artwork orders, basis points of commitValue, paid to SERVICE_FEE_ADDRESS (required when > 0 and STUDIO_URL is set).

MINT_ADMIN_API_KEYS_JSON.description: JSON array of hash-only @bsh/edge API key records for /v1/admin/*: [{"id","hash" (lower-case SHA-256 hex of the key),"scopes":["mint:admin"],"env"?,"name"?}]. env defaults to live on mainnet, test elsewhere (other envs refused). A record with a plaintext "key" is refused. Unset = every admin call is 401 (warned off regtest).

AMQP_URL.description: RabbitMQ URL (amqp(s)://user:pass@host:5672/vhost). Set: events are bridged onto the platform bus through @bsh/events connectAmqpBus and startup refuses if the broker does not answer. Required on mainnet; unset on signet/testnet only warns (events stay in-process).

AMQP_EXCHANGE.description: Topic exchange the platform bus publishes to (dead letters on <exchange>.dlx).

AMQP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Startup health check: connect + confirm channel + exchange declaration must finish within this (500-120000).
